# Welcome to Fundraise Up Docs

Explore guides and ideas to strengthen your fundraising with Fundraise Up.

## Onboarding guide

The place where it all begins. Think of this as your personal guide — just you, your organization, and Fundraise Up. We’ll walk through everything together, from setup to success.
